dataset: BLS Quarterly Census of Employment and Wages (QCEW)

source.note: National all-industry annual-average coverage table by ownership. Values are exact published QCEW totals.

definition_note: QCEW wages include gross covered wages such as bonuses and stock options but exclude employer contributions for Social Security, health insurance, unemployment insurance, workers' compensation, and most private pension/welfare funds. They are not equivalent to BEA compensation of employees.
